findings.narrative: The contract declares required_evidence='enforcement tests: posture matrix, product-class block on substrate/seeded/typed-skip-only, real-capture pass, defer/disposition allows close, substrate-plan warn (F005)' but no captured EvidenceRef artifact under evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/ has a uri or note containing this substring. Either the implementation didn't produce this artifact, the operator's matcher string drifted from the actual filename / note convention, or the contract should be updated to drop the requirement. Per D002 — this is a v1 evidence-coverage heuristic; the matcher only inspects uri / note metadata, not artifact bytes, and a hit would not certify journey correctness either.
